findings.highlight: "But you take to it an extreme. You're going to burn yourself out."
findings.evidenceJa: 「しかしな、衛宮のは度が過ぎるというか、このままいくと潰れるというか」
findings.governingReading: Issei searches for a formulation: Shirou goes too far, or perhaps will wear himself down if this continues.
findings.explanation: Issei's searching, reformulated warning becomes two blunt statements. His concern survives; the English also contains a local word-order error.
